LESSON: DRIVING TOOLS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT
Strand: Strand 4
Topic 4.2: Driving Tools
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 8

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Driving Tools, part of Strand 4 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade 9 PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES FOR LEARNERS WITH HEARING IMPAIRMENT.

Key inquiry question: How are different types of driving tools used to perform tasks?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Driving Tools together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Self-Efficacy: learner acquires effective communication skills in task execution when demonstrating safe use of driving

tools to perform different types of tasks.

• Digital Literacy: learner develops interacting skills use digital devices to watch a captioned video showing uses of driving

tools.

Values:
• Unity: learner cooperates with others when discussing on the safe use of driving tools.

• Responsibility: learner exercises accountability as they maintain and store driving tools.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

• Personal Safety and Security: learner demonstrates basic safety habits as they safely use driving tools to perform tasks.

• Disaster Risk Reduction: learner appreciates the need to clean and safely store driving tools.

Link to other subjects:

Agriculture and Nutrition: learner enhances the knowledge on use of farm tools during demonstration on how to use and

care for driving tools.

Suggested Learning Resources

• Digital devices such as; computer, laptop, smart phone, tablets among others.

• Career brochures, career magazines

• Driving tools (Screwdrivers, Hand wrenches, Nut drivers, T-handle wrenches Hammers, Screw driver, spanner, punches mallets
